title: Design System: Build Sprint Checkout Evidence

runtime.previewRequirement: Load the approved global custom-element runtime before rendering these snippets. Without it the panel cannot show Shopify component visuals. No custom CSS approximation or copied shadow-root styles are supplied.
runtime.stateOwnership: Official components own hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, and internal animation styles.

metric.purpose: Counts, percentages, observed test-order averages, and explicitly labeled modeled monetary values via s-number; fontSize is an official component keyword, not a CSS length.

containerQueries.name: metrics
containerQueries.purpose: Three metric columns above the container threshold, one below.

containerQueries.name: evidence-coverage
containerQueries.purpose: Two evidence sections above the container threshold, one below.

pageFrame.purpose: Use the frontmatter maximum width in the native grid column; shrink to available width on smaller screens. No custom visual CSS.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action; Shopify owns hover, focus, active, loading, and disabled states.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting evidence or disclosure action with official states.

components.name: Investigation Checkbox
components.description: Self-reported step; use checked and disabled properties.

components.name: View Navigation
components.description: Button navigation; selected state uses primary variant and aria-pressed.

components.name: Caution Badge
components.description: Investigation status, not a reward or verified incident.

components.name: Information Banner

components.name: Metric Number
components.description: Count, percentage, or clearly labeled modeled amount using the metric typography keyword.

components.name: Page Frame
components.description: Centered official grid, capped at the approved maximum and responsive to smaller screens.

narrative.overview:
Use Shopify App Home v2.0 web components for every visible interface element. This is the user-approved system change: official components own typography, colors, shapes, elevation, interaction states, and responsive behavior. The shipped runtime is https://cdn.shopify.com/shopifycloud/polaris-2.0-rc.js; local component definitions are pinned to @shopify/polaris-types@2.0.0-rc.0.

The health dashboard reference (health/Health Dashboard.dc.html) continues to guide information order and section purpose. Express that structure with official components; do not reproduce its custom HTML controls, dark hero, font files, palette, or card CSS. The screen should feel familiar and useful for investigating checkout evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Clear section headings, readable evidence, and restrained status emphasis.
Component keyword scales instead of custom visual values.
Responsive layouts composed with stacks, grids, and query containers.

rules.name: The Component Ownership Rule
rules.body: Use official component properties; do not assign custom CSS colors or copy internal shadow-root styles.

dos: Do use Shopify App Home v2.0 web components for every visible element.
Do use documented component properties and keyword scales checked against the pinned official manifest.
Do preserve the health reference’s useful section purposes through official components.
Do keep uncertainty and unavailable values visibly explained with official text and banners.
Do check populated overview and drill-down states at desktop and phone widths after component changes.
donts: Don’t reintroduce custom visual CSS, native styled controls, copied font files, or a separate palette.
Don’t recreate the removed calculator, visible points, or reward badges.
Don’t use status styling to imply a verified merchant incident, fix, or recovered money.
Don’t add Impact or Slack screens during milestone 1; their product plans remain in PRODUCT.md and PLAN.md.
